title: •The Emperor
caption: •The Emperor (V)
game_text: Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a non-Senate site opponent occupies. Each turn, may lose 1 Force (free in battle) to target a character present with him. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value. Gains {icon:republic} at opponent’s Senate.
lore: *Leader.* Secretive manipulator of the galaxy. Played Darth Vader and Prince Xizor off against one another in his relentless pursuit of “young Skywalker.”
copyright: © 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 7 / POLITICS 4 (third box is a value box); deploy 5 / forfeit 9. Margin credits printed vertically beside the slip: left 'Original concept by Mike Gemme', right '2002 Origins Winner' (margin_left / margin_right as vs6/20). Inline icon in 'Gains [icon] at opponent’s Senate': a silver/lilac sphere with the Galactic Republic crest = the PC Game Aid's 'Character - Republic' type icon (checked against the Feb 2024 Game Aid sheet) → written {icon:republic}; the stub reads it as 'Force icons', which it is not (the Force icons are squares). NOTE the renderer currently maps 'republic' to the maintenance wheel — a new inline asset is needed. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Affiliation: two discs top-left on the printed card — Dark Jedi Master (red blade) and Imperial (wiki subtype 'Dark Jedi Master/Imperial') → recorded 'Dark Jedi Master + Imperial'; frame is the Reflections II silver-grey Imperial-style character frame. Printed base is the Reflections II foil (wiki |set=Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy, expansion ring icon = Reflections II). Lore corrected from scan: 'Leader.' is printed bold (*Leader.*); curly double quotes around “young Skywalker.” (wiki straight single quotes); the lore box has NO first-line indent on this card (lore_indent 0, as the ANH Chewbacca). Copyright line read off the 354 px scan as the SE-style form with year 2000 ('© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.') — the run's default for Reflections II was 2001; low-res reading, verify on a better scan. Base scan only 354×492 (Ref2-D-theemperor.gif). Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3-D-theemperor-pre.gif, 354 px; non-pre also exists). The PDF v6.pdf in the scratchpad carries an older wording of this slip (…'At opponent's Senate, politics = 4 and game text may not be canceled') — the Dec 2006 crop is transcribed.
